itemized.notes: Page-face candidate 'Bill Lee' on the name line, signed and printed 'William C Lee' in the Report Verification block; index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the page face supplies it. Page-face Office Seeking reads 'Utah County Commission (Seat B)' IN THE FILER'S OWN HAND, which agrees with the channel's 'County Commission Seat B' — a seat that is PRINTED, not inferred. Party 'Republican', residence city Pleasant Grove. 4 pages, all four read full-page: p1 the county's 2014 blank cover ('2014 FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY & LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD CANDIDATES', Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5), report type '30 Days after the General Election' ticked, amendment answered 'No', signed 12/2/2014, clerk date-stamp 'DEC 3 AM11:48'; p2 the SUMMARY PAGE (located by its printed heading, and here it is also foliated 'Page 2 of 4' — this filer's foliation COUNTS THE COVER, one of the four conventions on record); p3 SCHEDULE A ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED, foliated 3 of 4; p4 SCHEDULE B ITEMIZED EXPENDITURES MADE, foliated 4 of 4. Both schedules are the standard 2014 underline blank — Schedule B correctly heads its payee column 'Purchased From/Source' (the 2014 fix to the 2012 'Name of Contributor' mislabel) and still prints NO Purpose column. Every donor and vendor Address cell on both sheets is an EMPTY PRINTED RULE: this filing is not redacted (no bar anywhere) and the form does print a city/zip column, so the blanks are the FILER's omission, the second of the four documented blank-address causes. THE WHOLE-DOLLAR COVER: the filer records cents on his expenditure figures (206.64, itemized to the cent) but writes the balance ladder in round dollars, so line 7 prints 9,042 where 9,249 - 206.64 = 9,042.36. That 0.36 is confined to the cover's closing-balance line, is uniquely attributable to the filer's own rounding, and changes NEITHER side's reconciliation — both close exactly. Nothing was recomputed or nudged. Cumulative Column B figures (contributions 49,320 / expenditures 40,277) are retained as cumulative and never summed as increments. Per the cover tranche's note this is the post-election report of the same filer as key e75df429, and its beginning balance 6,249 equals that report's closing balance — observed, but NO two covers were differenced and nothing here depends on that filing.
